what: Examiner round Q4-Q13: the second (typed) script registration path. CScript::MethodN/FunctionN functors found by RTTI; each row = one registration call site read from the image: script class, script name, the C++ function it binds (fn; a real typed method/function, not an argv handler), fewest/most = argc bounds as registered (count includes the command name, and the object for methods), ret/args = the functor's template arguments demangled from its TypeDescriptor (functor_td). Re-verify before use.
method: vtable imm stored in a helper (mov [reg],vt; TD of vt matches .?AV?$(Method|Function)N@...@CScript@@) -> callers of that helper -> pushed args (class,name,usage,fn[,this_adjust],fewest,most,extra); registers resolved from mov reg,imm / xor reg,reg
